description: Servicio de visualización WMS de incendios forestales is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoserveis.icgc.cat. WMS service for visualization of orthoimages related to wildfires. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "WMS view service of wildfires" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Servicio WMS, WMS service, Servei WMS. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.icgc.cat/condicions). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
